Return & Refund Policy

At AsbiMart, your trust and satisfaction come first. Every order is backed by our 7-day hassle-free return policy and 100% purity cashback guarantee.

🛡️

7-Day Return Window

Request a return or replacement within 7 days of receiving your order.

✅

100% Purity Guarantee

If any product fails our purity or quality promise, we refund 100% of your payment.

⚡

Fast 24–72h Refund

Verified refunds are sent directly via bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or Bank Transfer.

1 Eligible Conditions for Return

  • The product arrived damaged, leaking, broken, or with a tampered safety seal.
  • You received the wrong item, weight, or quantity compared to your confirmed order.
  • The product does not meet AsbiMart's 100% pure & organic quality standards upon taste or inspection.
  • For unopened items returned due to change of mind, original packaging and seal must remain intact within 7 days of delivery.

2 How to Request a Return or Replacement

  1. Contact our support team within 7 days of delivery via Hotline (01821-296056), WhatsApp (+880 1821-296056), or Email (asby056@gmail.com).
  2. Share your Order ID along with a short photo or description of the issue (if damaged or incorrect).
  3. Our rider or courier partner will arrange pickup from your address—at zero extra cost if the issue is from our side.
  4. Choose either a brand-new replacement dispatch or a full refund.

3 Refund Processing Timeline

Payment Method Refund Method Estimated Time
bKash / Nagad / Rocket Same Mobile Wallet 24 – 48 Hours
Cash on Delivery (COD) bKash / Nagad / Bank Transfer 24 – 72 Hours
Visa / Mastercard Original Card / Bank Reversal 3 – 7 Working Days

4 Instant Inspection Before Payment

With Cash on Delivery, you are always welcome to inspect your parcel in front of the delivery rider. If anything appears damaged or different from your order, you may return it immediately on the spot without paying any charge.
